overview:
Greg Casar, the Democratic incumbent, is running for reelection in a Texas district that leans heavily Democratic by about 30 points. He has raised over $1.1 million and holds nearly $600,000 in cash, while Republican Lauren Peña has raised about $118,000 and reports only $770 on hand, with no outside spending on either side.

No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals and the stark financial gap. Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97%, and the expected margin sits near 29 points, making this a Safe Democratic seat.
